monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement materially expands the purchase-ready dry-herb vaporizer guide with an exact-model recall screen, three-candidate identity table, proof-before-price checkout path, current 2026 CPSC remedy example, warranty evidence, and the existing ownership-cost calculator. It adds no seller, model recommendation, price, coupon, stock, rating, fabricated test, or paid placement.

image_qa.note: The allergy asset and vaporizer expansion use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No clinical, symptom, workplace, device, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed; the CPSC recall is described in text and linked to the exact official notice, so no ambiguous product depiction was introduced.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. It is seven days old and usable, but no unaddressed page or query had meaningful volume in the roughly position-4-to-20 band, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub signal (three impressions, one click, position 7.3) was acted on October 26; Stem Cell CBG (19 impressions, one click, position 6.0) was materially reinforced October 15 and October 24. About and Contact are navigational, Montana and one-impression rows are too small, and Blue Dream positions around 48–70 are outside the target band. Today's work therefore uses verified evergreen gaps and a current product-safety update without inventing an analytics mandate.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis allergy and exposure record grounded in CDC/NIOSH, NIH MedlinePlus, a 2026 NIOSH Health Hazard Evaluation, and the international consensus review. It separates urgent signs, plant contact, inhalation, finished-product ingredients, workplace exposures, observable timing, testing limits, and a one-page clinician handoff. Reciprocal contextual links from the edible-allergen, lung-health, and clinician-conversation pages strengthen the health-and-exposure cluster. No outreach was sent and no speculative outreach target was logged.
